Sunday customer printer test

Print one customer’s Sunday order to the Epson. Your phone or tablet must be on the same Wi-Fi as the printer, including when testing at home. Nothing on this page accepts an order or changes its status.

1. Choose the ticket

For real orders, sign in to the loyalty app as staff or admin on this same website first. The sample needs no sign-in.

2. Check and print

Enter the printer’s current address. It can change when moving from shop Wi-Fi to home Wi-Fi. This test uses HTTPS and does not change the KDS printer settings.





After sending, check the paper at the printer. If confirmation is missing, check for a ticket before retrying to avoid duplicates.

(function(){'use strict';const C=SundayRoast,A=SundayApi,$=id=>document.getElementById(id),d=C.empty();function esc(s){return String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c]))}function rows(kind,cat){return Object.entries(cat).map(([k,x])=>`<label class="field">${esc(x.name)} — ${C.money(x.price)}<input class="input qty" data-kind="${kind}" data-key="${k}" type="number" min="0" max="50" step="1" value="0"></label>`).join('')}function sync(){document.querySelectorAll('[data-kind]').forEach(i=>{d[i.dataset.kind][i.dataset.key]=Math.max(0,Math.min(50,parseInt(i.value||'0',10)||0))});d.name=$('name').value.trim();d.phone=$('phone').value.trim();d.slot=$('slot').value;let paid=Math.max(0,Math.round((Number($('paid').value)||0)*100)),total=C.total(d);if($('payment').value==='paid_full')paid=total;if($('payment').value==='unpaid')paid=0;paid=Math.min(total,paid);$('paid').value=(paid/100).toFixed(2);$('total').textContent=C.money(total);$('balance').textContent=C.money(total-paid);return{total,paid}}async function load(){try{const s=await A.status($('date').value||undefined);const c=s.config;$('date').value=c.date;$('slot').innerHTML=c.slots.map(x=>`<option value="${esc(x)}">${esc(x)}</option>`).join('');sync()}catch(e){$('message').textContent=e.message}}$('meals').innerHTML=rows('meals',C.meals);$('extras').innerHTML=rows('extras',C.extras);document.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(e.target.matches('[data-kind],#paid,#name,#phone'))sync()});$('payment').onchange=sync;$('date').onchange=load;$('save').onclick=async()=>{try{$('message').textContent='';const p=sync();if(!d.name)throw Error('Enter the customer name.');if((d.phone.match(/\d/g)||[]).length<7)throw Error('Enter a valid phone number.');if(!C.lines(d).some(x=>x.kind==='meals'))throw Error('Choose at least one Sunday Roast dinner.');if(!d.slot)throw Error('Choose a collection time.');if($('payment').value==='deposit_paid'&&p.paid<=0)throw Error('Enter the deposit already paid.');if($('payment').value==='deposit_paid'&&p.paid>=p.total)throw Error('Choose Paid in Full when the whole order is paid.');$('save').disabled=true;const r=await A.staffCreate({collection_date:$('date').value,collection_slot:d.slot,customer_name:d.name,customer_phone:d.phone,meals:d.meals,extras:d.extras,payment_status:$('payment').value,amount_paid_pence:p.paid,request_id:crypto.randomUUID()});$('message').textContent='Sunday Roast SR-'+String(r.order.order_number).padStart(3,'0')+' added successfully.';for(const k of Object.keys(d.meals))d.meals[k]=0;for(const k of Object.keys(d.extras))d.extras[k]=0;document.querySelectorAll('[data-kind]').forEach(i=>i.value='0');$('paid').value='0.00';sync()}catch(e){$('message').textContent=e.message}finally{$('save').disabled=false}};load();})();
